_comment: Manually maintained. passiveTreeByClass maps Maxroll classId to the treeID in passives.json. masteriesByClass uses Maxroll's per-class relative mastery IDs (1-3); mastery 0 = no mastery yet (plain class). Confirmed from real exports: Rogue 1=Bladedancer 2=Marksman 3=Falconer; Sentinel 2=Void Knight. Classes listed in unverifiedMasteries have never been checked against an export — paste one per mastery to confirm.
